title: LEAD-chi: analysis code, protocol and QC grades for a procedurally blinded QSM study of midbrain susceptibility in psychosis-spectrum youth
description: Analysis code (processing, blinding, QC, registered analysis, exploratory and post hoc validation, human visual-QC kits, figure scripts), the internally SHA-256 time-stamped protocol with all amendments and the deviation log, compact result files, and the AI and human visual-QC grades for a secondary QSM analysis (QSMxT v9.22.0) of substantia nigra-ventral tegmental area susceptibility in psychosis-spectrum youth with ADHD modeled factorially (2 x 2), using OpenNeuro ds007116. Code was written with Claude Code (Anthropic) under the first author's direction.
notes: Protocol, documentation and result files are licensed CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-docs); code is MIT. Article: Velioglu HA, Altunc AT, Celik MC, Aslan D, Cicek Y, Sakiroglu MA. Midbrain susceptibility in psychosis-spectrum youth: a procedurally blinded quantitative susceptibility mapping study with ADHD modeled factorially. (submitted)
